stem_book: A bullet of mass m moving with velocity u just grazes the top of a solid cylinder of mass m and radius R resting on a rough horizontal surface as shown in figure. Assume that the cylinder rolls without slipping and that the bullet leaves with the same velocity as the top point of the cylinder. Then the final velocity of the bullet is: (a) 8u/11 (b) 7u/17 (c) 5u/12 (d) 9u/13
reason: Needs the unstated condition that the bullet ends with the top-point velocity 2V; added to stem.
work: About contact point: mu(2R) = m(2V)(2R) + (3/2)mR²(V/R) ⇒ V = 4u/11, bullet v = 2V = 8u/11
